body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range; up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. Independently, each chosen ally may move 1 unit toward you or the enemy; alone, you may move 1 unit.

surges.html: Increase one creature's movement by 1 unit.
After a hit, one moved creature becomes Rallied until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when one moved creature begins its next Action before your next turn: it ignores one ordinary -1 Success Die penalty for that Action.
